gen-gf-warnes-gf-sofia-sans-semi-condens: Stretched out and swaggering, Warnes tapers every stroke to a point. Sofia Sans Semi Condensed is the quieter one, its lowercase standing nearly as tall as its capitals and each curve entering with a visible lead-in.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-savate: Savate reads sturdy and open, its round o nearly as tall as a capital. Grandstander is the bolder voice, drawing flat-weight lines where Savate carries a light shading through each word.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-readex-pro: Wide-set and commanding, Goldman spreads its letters out with round forms like open parentheses, while Readex Pro keeps a steady weight. Big gestures meet quiet manners.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-prompt: Prompt has small letters that look oversized, with open apertures that read easily, under Autour One's level, accent-free beat. The text should glide along without snagging.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-onest: Funnel Display draws spaghetti-like strokes of one width, with c tips that stay well apart and little gap between capitals and lowercase. And Onest, with short ascenders above big bowls, can sit a notch larger than you'd expect.
gen-eater-gf-noto-sans-soyombo: Dark, spiky and a bit menacing. Eater carries a lightly flexed spring-wire contrast up top, while Noto Sans Soyombo follows with a sizable x-height and wide-mouthed curves that keep the page legible.
gen-flavors-gf-noto-sans-sinhala: Noto Sans Sinhala lays a thick, dark stripe of lowercase through each line, its curve endings never crowding. Flavors, whimsical and stout, keeps a single stroke width.
gen-audiowide-gf-noto-sans-ethiopic: Noto Sans Ethiopic stands tall and sturdy, with c terminals hanging far from the bowl. Audiowide, glyphs set like tiles with wide grout lines, gives it a futuristic, rounded-wire edge.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-stack-sans-headline: Stack Sans Headline reads crisp, with wide gaps that hold up at tiny sizes. Under Gugi's distinctive tall lowercase, a deep middle band and monoline skeleton keep a long run of text moving smoothly.
gen-irish-grover-fs-bespoke-sans: Irish Grover is fun and organic, its tall lowercase making words look sturdy and large, with open throats on a, c, e and s. Bespoke Sans stays sharper and more refined beneath.
